caption: The video captures a static view through a window onto a snowy backyard, with a dark horizontal sill running across the bottom of the frame. Blurred leafless trees stand on the left while a wooden fence recedes toward a snow-capped pergola on the right. A mound of granular snow rests on the sill in the foreground, and fine white snowflakes drift steadily downward across the whole scene. Over the course of the clip the top edge of the foreground mound climbs and rounds out, growing plumper on the left as falling flakes settle onto its surface. The background fence, trees, and sill line hold their positions, so the change reads as vertical accumulation rather than camera movement. The light snowfall continues without pause, the crest still rising as the visible portion runs out.
